CapStablecoin.$comment: Cap cUSD leg. Registered via addBalanceAdapters, alongside its CapSavings sibling — the former single `Cap` key registered one contract that served both legs.

CapSavings.$comment: Cap stcUSD leg. Registered via addBalanceAdapters, alongside its CapStablecoin sibling.

Cap.$comment: RETIRED, and this entry is load-bearing rather than documentation. The pre-split combined Cap adapter (0x5B50A5FF...) is REGISTERED on the live mainnet NAV. It is superseded by CapStablecoin + CapSavings above. `deregister: true` makes 06_Configure call removeBalanceAdapters for it; without that an incremental deploy leaves all three registered and DOUBLE-COUNTS both Cap legs. Delete this entry only once the adapter is confirmed deregistered on every chain that had it.

EtherFiWithdrawalQueueAssisted.$comment: ether.fi withdrawal-queue assisted adapter (ADR 0018/0030). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports the account's cached WithdrawRequestNFT ids, fed by its assistant or the SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper.

NexusMutualStakingPoolsAssisted.$comment: Nexus Mutual staking pools assisted adapter (ADR 0018/0030). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports the account's staked NXM (Staking + Rewards) per StakingNFT position (positionId = abi.encode(stakingPoolAddress)), valued live from ids fed by its assistant or the SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper (ownership re-verified per read).

StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssisted.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue assisted adapter (ADR 0018/0030). Registered via addBalanceAdapters; reports the account's cached (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples, fed by its assistant or the SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper.
